title: Wake-Word Keyword Spotting
description: An original, self-contained implementation of the Wake-Word Keyword Spotting concept, built for the Foundev portfolio. It focuses on the core workflow described in the project brief and keeps the architecture small enough to read end to end.
problem_solved: Build an always-listening wake-word recognizer for smart devices using the Google Speech Commands dataset with quantization for on-device deployment. Actual implementation note: Synthetic positive phrase and negative background clips
target_audience: Intermediate learners with basic Python familiarity; some projects require additional math, data, or system prerequisites.
prerequisites: Introductory probability and supervised learning; read the project prerequisite guide for project-specific needs
learning_outcomes: Explain the implementation stages of Wake-Word Keyword Spotting using named source files.
Separate model or algorithm behavior from its interface, data pipeline, and configured dependencies.
Inspect likely failure modes, metrics, limitations, privacy, and human-review needs appropriate to the application.
Propose a reproducible, source-aligned extension and test plan.
estimated_completion_time: 18–30 hours, depending on optional data/model downloads
